from.place: Proof paragraph 2, finite-coefficient mapping-complex adjunction: foundational left-fibration indexing model. Change of the target simplicial category for unmarked cone straightening; identifies the cone diagram over the counit with the left Kan extension of the cone diagram over C[S] in the ordinary-base straightening comparison (step 8 of lem-coef-space-valued-straightening).

title: Unmarked cone straightening along a change of target is enriched left Kan extension
statement:
Use simplicial sets of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and the small simplicial categories, coherent realization $\mathfrak C$, ordered cone $X\star\Delta^0$ with last vertex $v$, cone pushout and enriched natural transformations of [lem-coef-unmarked-straightening-quillen]. Fix a small simplicial set $S$, small simplicial categories $D$ and $D'$, a simplicial functor $\phi:\mathfrak C[S]\to D^{\mathrm{op}}$ and a simplicial functor $\pi:D\to D'$, and put $\phi'=\pi^{\mathrm{op}}\circ\phi:\mathfrak C[S]\to D'^{\mathrm{op}}$. For $a:X\to S$ and $\psi\in\{\phi,\phi'\}$ with target $E^{\mathrm{op}}$ ($E=D$ or $E=D'$), put $M_{a,\psi}=\mathfrak C[X\star\Delta^0]\amalg_{\mathfrak C[X]}E^{\mathrm{op}}$, the categorical pushout of simplicial categories along $\psi\circ\mathfrak C[a]$, and let $L_\psi(X):E\to\mathsf{sSet}$ be $e\mapsto M_{a,\psi}(e,v)$ with action by precomposition. Write $\pi^*G=G\circ\pi$ for a simplicial functor $G:D'\to\mathsf{sSet}$, and $\pi_!$ for enriched left Kan extension, the left adjoint of $\pi^*$ on simplicial functors and enriched natural transformations, characterized by natural bijections $\operatorname{Nat}(\pi_!H,G)\cong\operatorname{Nat}(H,\pi^*G)$.

The simplicial functor $M_{a,\phi}\to M_{a,\phi'}$ which is $\pi^{\mathrm{op}}$ on $D^{\mathrm{op}}$ and the identity on $\mathfrak C[X\star\Delta^0]$ fixes $v$ and induces a natural map $L_\phi(X)\to\pi^*L_{\phi'}(X)$. Its adjoint
$$\pi_!L_\phi(X)\longrightarrow L_{\phi'}(X)$$
is an isomorphism of simplicial functors $D'\to\mathsf{sSet}$, natural in $X$ over $S$. Equivalently, defining $U_\psi(G)$ to have as $n$-simplices over $\sigma:\Delta^n\to S$ the enriched natural maps $L_\psi(\Delta^n\xrightarrow{\sigma}S)\to G$, with operators induced by simplex operators, there is an isomorphism of simplicial sets over $S$, $U_{\phi'}(G)\cong U_\phi(\pi^*G)$, natural in $G:D'\to\mathsf{sSet}$. These isomorphisms are the identity for $\pi=\mathrm{id}$, compatible with composites $D\to D'\to D''$, and compatible with maps $X\to Y$ over $S$. No Kan, local Kan, Dwyer--Kan, fibrancy or cofibrancy hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Section 2.2.1, the straightening construction (St_phi X)(C)=Map_M(C,v) (printed p.73), and Proposition 2.2.1.1(2) (printed p.74), which HTT calls an obvious functoriality property and states without proof; the right-adjoint form follows by adjunction. Read in the sandbox copy of the PDF (April 9, 2017 text); not archived in literature/. No Stacks tag states this result. The marked analogue is part of lem-coef-marked-cone-straightening-quillen, which assumes a locally Kan target and so does not apply to the identity of C[S].
